summary: Import-time fetch to mutable personal GitHub raw URL
details: On require, lib/index.js performs an unconditional fetch to https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alannzxd/xclient/refs/heads/main/information.json and prints the parsed JSON message via console.log. The response body is not passed to eval, exec, or any child-process or interpreter sink, so as currently written there is no remote code execution and no installer data is sent outward. However, the destination is a mutable branch under a personal GitHub account, meaning the served content can be changed at any time without a package republish, and the import-time outbound network call breaks offline / air-gapped installs and prints attacker-controlled text to consumer logs. The package is also a fork of the popular @whiskeysockets/baileys WhatsApp library under a personal scope, which is a name/brand-proximity concern worth human review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
